projects.name: New greenfield smelter in Gresik, Indonesia
projects.quote: In July 2021, PT-FI awarded a construction contract with an estimated cost of $2.8 billion.

projects.name: PT Smelting expansion
projects.quote: PT-FI completed agreements in November 2021 with the majority owner of PT Smelting to implement the expansion plans.

projects.name: Precious metals refinery (PMR)
projects.quote: • Construction of a precious metals refinery (PMR) to process gold and silver from the new greenfield smelter and PT Smelting at an estimated cost of $250 million.

projects.name: PT-FI dual-fuel power plant
projects.quote: PT-FI is also advancing construction of a dual- fuel power plant and upgrades to the mill circuit to improve recoveries.
